SELECT s.id, s.`name`, s.id_time_zone, t.`value` AS time_zone_value, s.start_date_time, s.end_date_time, s.cf_start_time, s.cf_end_time, s.ac_capacity, s.dc_capacity FROM site s INNER JOIN time_zone t ON t.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE s.`status` = 1 AND s.`is_delete` = 0 AND s.cf_start_time IS NOT NULL AND s.cf_end_time IS NOT NULL AND ( (s.cf_start_time < s.cf_end_time AND HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', t.`value`)) >= s.cf_start_time AND HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', t.`value`)) <= s.cf_end_time) OR (s.cf_start_time > s.cf_end_time AND ( HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', t.`value`)) >= s.cf_start_time OR HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', t.`value`)) <= s.cf_end_time )) ) AND s.run_on_server IN
#{item}
AND s.id IN ( select id_site from error_level_site_map where id_error_level = #{error_level} )
GROUP BY s.id
SELECT a.id_device, a.id_error, a.start_date, a.end_date FROM `alert_new` a WHERE a.id_device = #{id_device} AND a.id_error = #{id_error} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.end_date IS NULL LIMIT 1

WITH base AS ( SELECT d.id_device, d.time, d.error, CASE WHEN d.error != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS error_flag FROM ${data_table_name} d INNER JOIN device dv ON dv.id = d.id_device AND dv.is_delete = 0 AND dv.status = 1 INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = dv.id_site WHERE d.id_device = #{id_device} AND d.time >= DATE_ADD(#{time_execute}, INTERVAL -(#{time_query_no_comm_threshold_minutes} + CASE s.data_send_time WHEN 1 THEN 4 WHEN 2 THEN 14 WHEN 3 THEN 2 END) MINUTE) AND d.time <= #{time_execute} ), marked AS ( SELECT *, LAG(error_flag) OVER ( PARTITION BY id_device ORDER BY time ) AS prev_error_flag FROM base ), grouped AS ( SELECT *, SUM( CASE WHEN prev_error_flag IS NULL OR error_flag <> prev_error_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY id_device ORDER BY time ) AS group_idx FROM marked ) SELECT id_device, MIN(time) AS start_time, MAX(time) AS end_time, COUNT(*) AS points, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, MIN(time), MAX(time) ) AS time_diff_minutes FROM grouped WHERE error_flag = 1 GROUP BY id_device, group_idx HAVING time_diff_minutes >= #{time_no_comm_threshold_minutes} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH base AS ( SELECT d.time, d.error, case when d.nvmActivePower > 0 OR d.error > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 end as nvm_active_power_flag, (s.cf_end_time - s.cf_start_time) * 60 as production_off_time, LAG(d.time) OVER ( ORDER BY d.time ) AS prev_time, LAG(d.error) OVER ( ORDER BY d.time ) AS prev_error, LAG(case when d.nvmActivePower > 0 OR d.error > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) OVER ( ORDER BY d.time ) AS prev_nvm_active_power_flag FROM ${data_table_name} d INNER JOIN device dv ON dv.id = d.id_device AND dv.is_delete = 0 AND dv.status = 1 INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = dv.id_site INNER JOIN time_zone tz ON tz.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE d.id_device = #{id_device} AND d.time >= DATE_ADD(#{time_execute}, INTERVAL -(#{time_query_no_prod_threshold_minutes} + CASE s.data_send_time WHEN 1 THEN 4 WHEN 2 THEN 14 WHEN 3 THEN 2 END) MINUTE) AND d.time <= #{time_execute} AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(d.TIME, "UTC", tz.`value`)) >= concat(s.cf_start_time,':00') AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(d.TIME, "UTC", tz.`value`)) <= concat(s.cf_end_time,':00') ), groups_data AS ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_time IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN prev_error <> error THEN 1 WHEN prev_nvm_active_power_flag <> nvm_active_power_flag THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, prev_time, time ) >= production_off_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group FROM base ), numbered AS ( SELECT *, SUM(new_group) OVER ( ORDER BY time ) AS group_id FROM groups_data ) SELECT MIN(time) AS start_time, MAX(time) AS end_time, COUNT(*) AS points, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, MIN(time), MAX(time) ) as time_diff_minutes, group_id FROM numbered where nvm_active_power_flag = 0 GROUP BY group_id HAVING time_diff_minutes > #{time_no_prod_threshold_minutes} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(d.time) as time FROM ${data_table_name} d;

mapper.select: SELECT al.*, d.datatablename, d.id_device_type as id_device_type_int, s.id as id_site, s.cf_alert_threshold FROM alert_new al INNER JOIN device d ON d.id = al.id_device INNER JOIN error e ON e.id = al.id_error AND e.id_device_group = d.id_device_group INNER JOIN site s on s.id = d.id_site WHERE al.end_date IS NULL AND al.`status` = 1 AND al.is_delete = 0 AND al.resolved = 0 AND d.`status` = 1 AND d.is_delete = 0 AND e.error_code = #{error_code} AND e.`status` = 1 AND e.is_delete = 0 AND s.`status` = 1 AND s.is_delete = 0

WITH base AS ( SELECT d.id_device, d.time, d.error, CASE WHEN d.error != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS error_flag FROM ${data_table_name} d INNER JOIN device dv ON dv.id = d.id_device AND dv.is_delete = 0 AND dv.status = 1 INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = dv.id_site WHERE d.id_device = #{id_device} AND d.time > #{time_alert_start} ), marked AS ( SELECT *, LAG(error_flag) OVER ( PARTITION BY id_device ORDER BY time ) AS prev_error_flag FROM base ), grouped AS ( SELECT *, SUM( CASE WHEN prev_error_flag IS NULL OR error_flag <> prev_error_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( PARTITION BY id_device ORDER BY time ) AS group_idx FROM marked ) SELECT id_device, MIN(time) AS start_time, MAX(time) AS end_time, COUNT(*) AS points, error_flag, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, MIN(time), MAX(time) ) AS time_diff_minutes FROM grouped WHERE error_flag = 0 GROUP BY id_device, group_idx HAVING time_diff_minutes >= #{time_no_comm_threshold_minutes} ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 1

WITH base AS ( SELECT d.id_device, d.`time`, d.error, CASE WHEN d.nvmActivePower <= 0 OR d.error > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS error_flag FROM ${data_table_name} d INNER JOIN device dv ON dv.id = d.id_device AND dv.is_delete = 0 AND dv.STATUS = 1 INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = dv.id_site WHERE d.id_device = #{id_device} AND d.`time` > #{time_alert_start} ), marked AS (SELECT *, LAG(error_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY id_device ORDER BY TIME) AS prev_error_flag FROM base), grouped AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_error_flag IS NULL OR error_flag != prev_error_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY id_device ORDER BY TIME) AS group_idx FROM marked ) SELECT id_device, MIN(TIME) AS start_time, MAX(TIME) AS end_time, COUNT(*) AS points, error_flag, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MIN(TIME), MAX(TIME)) AS time_diff_minutes FROM grouped WHERE error_flag = 0 GROUP BY id_device, group_idx HAVING time_diff_minutes >= #{time_no_prod_threshold_minutes} ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 1
